result: Pass: candidate 4 reference silhouette, actual skin anatomy, bounded contact/loop and final movie frame progression accepted
scope: New reference-based naturalness acceptance. Previous locomotion stability checks are not evidence that the old Run looks natural.
reference_observations: Leading forepaw reaches forward of the shoulder while the opposite foreleg is folded.
One hindlimb is visibly extended behind the hip, creating a clear propulsive silhouette.
Paws and wrist/hock segments form continuous anatomical limb silhouettes.
A single still provides extension/drive direction, not a timed footfall or force measurement.

reasons: Low symmetric horizontal paw excursion and identical bounded sin-squared swing clearance remove captured late-swing reach and gathered recovery.
Fixed or near-fixed paw pitch plus constrained metatarsal profile suppress toe pointing and the distinction between landing and push-off.
Root/capture timing can be numerically correct while the skinned silhouette resembles a sped-up short-step walk.
previous_run_diagnosis.code_observation: Previous foot_path uses source.x only for bounded lateral movement; measured source ankle forward/height coordinates and source lift do not drive the authored forward/clearance profile.

acceptance.criterion: A leading forelimb clearly reaches forward/down before contact, with a visibly folded opposite forelimb; stronger extension than previous Run.
Hind drive visibly extends behind the hips, followed by knees and paws gathering forward beneath the body without reversed hocks.
Extended and gathered silhouettes alternate with body compression/extension and appropriate pitch/height cadence; leg speed alone does not carry the motion.
Paws/toes, wrist, forearm, stifle and hock remain connected in actual skin, without obvious disconnected ankle gaps, implausible U-bends or sharp fold collapses.
At least one clearly visible four-paw flight phase, supported paws consistent with declared travel speed, and a stable repeat boundary.
